tasks.subject: Task 0: Project Setup & Chart.js Bundle
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Scaffold directories and bundle Chart.js for offline use.

**Files:**
- Create: `latencyguard/src/lib/chart.min.js`
- Create: `latencyguard/src/components/` (directory)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `lib/chart.min.js` contains Chart.js 4.4.0 UMD build
- [ ] `Chart` global is available when script is loaded
- [ ] `components/` directory exists

**Verify:** Open in browser → `typeof Chart` returns `"function"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["latencyguard/src/lib/chart.min.js"], "verifyCommand": "ls -la latencyguard/src/lib/chart.min.js && ls -d latencyguard/src/components/", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Chart.js 4.4.0 UMD bundled", "components directory exists"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Design System CSS
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Complete rewrite of `app.css` with v4-refined dark frosted glass design tokens.

**Files:**
- Modify: `latencyguard/src/app.css` (full rewrite)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] All v4-refined tokens in `:root` (dark backgrounds, teal accent, status colors)
- [ ] `.glass` utility class with blur(16px)
- [ ] Body background uses dual radial gradients
- [ ] No light-theme tokens remain

**Verify:** `grep -c 'fbfbfd\|FF3B30' latencyguard/src/app.css` → 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["latencyguard/src/app.css"], "verifyCommand": "grep -c 'fbfbfd' latencyguard/src/app.css", "acceptanceCriteria": ["All v4-refined tokens defined", "Glass utility class", "No light-theme tokens"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

- Modify: `latencyguard/src/app.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Header: teal logo, sys chips, mode switcher (Simple/Monitor/Expert)
- [ ] Status bar at bottom with clock
- [ ] app.js routes to renderSimpleView/renderMonitorView/renderExpertView

- Create: `latencyguard/src/components/cpu-heatmap.js`
- Create: `latencyguard/src/components/dpc-timeline.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] renderScoreRing(score, size) returns SVG markup
- [ ] renderCpuHeatmap(cpuData) returns 4x4 grid HTML
- [ ] createDpcTimeline(canvasId) returns Chart instance
